correctness.rationale: Order the points cyclically; normalized circular angular gaps have Dirichlet(1,...,1) distribution. The exact identities P=2sum sin(G_i/2), A=0.5sum sin G_i give P=2pi-S3/24+S5/1920+O(S7), A=pi-S3/12+S5/240+O(S7). Dirichlet factorial moments yield covariance limit v_kl=(k+l)!-(1+kl)k!l!, specifically v33=360,v35=28800,v55=3254400. The least-squares projection coefficient Cov(S3,S5)/Var(S3)=320pi^2 n^-2+O(n^-3) removes cubic-predictable S5 variation; exact rational arithmetic independently verifies projected constant 2^10/320^2*(3254400-28800^2/360)=9504, perimeter 40 and correlation deficit 9504/(2*160)=297/10. Exponential spacings and the multivariate delta method prove jointly Gaussian limits and orthogonal Gaussian independence. Remainder S7 is L2-small via exact Dirichlet moments. No unsupported inference from finite-n numeric simulations.
residual_risks: Finite numerical corroboration is explicitly distinguished from the quantified analytic proof or exhaustive finite certificate.

value.rationale: For two canonical jointly measured geometric observables, leading correlation tends to one but hides a new finer-scale fluctuation. The exact best linear predictor quantifies how much area uncertainty remains when perimeter is known: residual variance is only 33/113 of the previously studied fixed-slope remainder. The joint independent Gaussian limits and correlation coefficient give a transferable statistical description of random cyclic hulls; this is a nontrivial optimal-projection refinement, not a rebranding of a known fixed combination.
residual_risks: Value assessment is mathematical usefulness of the precise new claim, not an assertion of broad downstream impact or publication prestige.

final_claim: For n independent uniform points on the unit circle, the optimal population linear regression slope of hull area on full perimeter is beta_n=2-24pi^2/n^2+O(n^-3), with centered residual variance asymptotic to 9504pi^10/n^9, correlation 1-rho_n~297pi^4/(10n^4), and a joint Gaussian limit of leading perimeter fluctuation and residual with independent coordinates and variances 40pi^6 and 9504pi^10. The older fixed-slope 2 cancellation/limit is prior.
limitations: Only iid uniform circular angle samples on unit radius; limit n->infinity, population least-squares linear prediction, unrestricted intercept. No nonlinear conditional expectation claim. Published fixed extrapolation is excluded from novelty. Historical priority risks remain.
